messages:
maya: Quick sync — procurement ledger shows 10 pending H100 reservations for Q3 but the reservation manifest only lists 6. Anyone reconciling?

alex: I pulled the ledger. Two shipments marked 'pending invoice', two 'on hold' (serial mismatch). The manifest we uploaded is the vendor_PR_0423.csv one we got last week. :thinking_face:

sasha: I reconciled one of the serial mismatches yesterday — vendor sent RU mapping for a different PO. I can push the diff to the procurement tracker in a sec.

maya: thanks. Can you paste the diff here or link the ticket? I don't want surprises during rack QA.

sasha: Sure — created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3241 and attached the CSV diff. Quick snippet: 
```
- PO12345,H100,SN:HX9-111,zone-a-rack-12
+ PO12345,H100,SN:HX9-111,zone-b-rack-03
```
Vendor corrected RU but not the invoice mapping.

alex: @dan FYI — two invoices are still pending approval because numbers don't match the PO. Can someone in finance re-check?

dan: on it. I'll ping finance and the vendor now. If invoices don't clear by EOD tomorrow we should mark those reservations as "hold" in the manifest so we don't double-book.

procurement-bot: Ticket INFRA-3241 created and assigned to sasha. ETA for vendor response: 48h. :robot_face:

maya: There's also a capacity reservation overlap flagged by the scheduler: reservation pool 'dedicated-q3-a' has 8 active reservations for 10 planned GPUs but two of those point to the same rack units (conflict). This is causing the manifest->scheduler mismatch.

alex: That's because the manifest import uses the vendor RU column when available. If vendor RU is wrong, scheduler duplicates assignments. We should fall back to 'rack-reserve-id' when RU conflict detected. I'll open a PR to add a validation step to the import job.

sasha: Good call. The PR should also emit a slack alert when conflicts are found so ops can triage before acceptance.

maya: Can we add a preflight check list for the next staging burn? Quick items: invoice cleared, serials reconciled, RU mapping validated, PDUs/AC load confirmed, smoke nodes allocated. I'll paste a checklist and owners.

alex: I'll own RU validation + import job PR.

sasha: I'll finish vendor reconciliation and attach corrected manifest.

dan: I'll coordinate finance approvals and confirm invoices or escalate.

ops-bot: Created runbook task: "staging-preflight-2025-07" assigned to eng-infra on 2025-07-08. See https://ops.redwood.internal/tasks/6009

maya: Also need a quick sanity check on power. Rack PDUs in zone-b are 32A max; if we densify H100 we might need to spread across two PDUs or lower clock skew. Can infra-sre confirm? @alex can you add the rack power numbers to INFRA-3241?

alex: Added PDU details and per-rack amp draw to the ticket. Short excerpt: "rack-03: 2x PDUs 32A, expected draw with 8 H100 @ 350W each = ~2.8kW -> ~12A per PDU (accounting for overhead)". :white_check_mark:

maya: Great. Timeline? If vendor fixes manifest + finance clears invoices, we can proceed with the staging burn next week. If not, fallback is cloud-burst capacity for first 48h of traffic.

sasha: Vendor replied to INFRA-3241 — they will re-issue corrected invoices within 24h.

dan: Finance says they can fast-track two invoices, will update by EOD today.

maya: Perfect. Action items recap:
- alex: PR for import validation + add slack alert (owner)
- sasha: complete vendor manifest fix and attach to INFRA-3241 (owner)
- dan: finance approvals or escalate (owner)
- infra-sre: final power signoff during smoke (owner: TBD)

maya: I'll follow up in the morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: acked. :eyes:

sasha: thanks — will post status in INFRA-3241 as soon as invoice corrected.

procurement-bot: Reminder: vendor invoice window for PO12345 closes in 72h.

maya: closing loop — if anything blocks the burn, please flag here so we can flip to cloud-burst plan.

dan: noted. Will escalate if finance blocks.

maya: good night team.
